Ship

The Ship or Ship Navigator is a feature unlocked at  Fishing V (5) that allows the player to travel to the  Backwater Bayou and  Lotus Atoll.

Accessing

[edit | edit source]

The Ship can be first accessed in the  Fishing Outpost by speaking to Captain Baha, after unlocking  Fishing V (5). He will task the player with fishing up and bringing him the  Rusty Ship Engine, which can then be applied to the Ship Navigator to unlock it.

The ship can then be seen on other Fishing islands, including the  Backwater Bayou and  Lotus Atoll.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

Ship Navigator

[edit | edit source]

The front of the Ship features a SHIP NAVIGATOR hologram. Clicking it opens a menu that allows the players to travel to certain Fishing-related islands.

Each of these islands have their own requirements, Sea Creatures, and Chapters associated with them. Completing all the chapters for a given island will unlock its Golden Pearl.

Ship Crew

[edit | edit source]

The Ship Crew is a feature unlocked at  Fishing X (10) that allows the player to persuade NPCs to join the ship. Each crewmate grants a unique reward, which can include access to new Fishing islands, and can be seen visibly on the ship.

Despite the unlock requirement, Captain Baha is always visibly part of the crew, although his ☯ Fishing Wisdom buff does still require  Fishing X (10).

Slot NPC Perk
Captain Baha +0.5 ☯ Fishing Wisdom
Researcher Gilbert Access to the  Lotus Atoll.

Ship Parts

[edit | edit source]

Certain items can be applied to the Ship to grant permanent Stats and SkyBlock XP:

Bronze Ship Helm +0.5 ☯ Fishing Wisdom
+5 SkyBlock XP 		Crafted using  64 Dark Oak Log and  4 Bronze Bowl.
Bronze Ship Engine Purchased from Junker Joel for  64 Rusty Coin and  8 Busted Belt Buckle.
Bronze Ship Hull Crafted using  3 Torn Cloth and  3 Bronze Bowl.

Golden Pearls

[edit | edit source]

Golden Pearls are rewards that can be earned on each Fishing island after completing its final Chapter. Each pearl grants a special perk.

Slot Pearl Island Rewards
Pearl of the Swamp  Backwater Bayou +1  Treasure Chance
Pearl of the Lotus  Lotus Atoll +2.5  Trophy Chance

Renaming

[edit | edit source]

The Ship has various default names, but can be renamed. Names can only contain letters or numbers.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Despite not being a confirmed Fishing Island, an island named World's End is implied to be the final Fishing Island unlocked as per Captain Baha's dialogue.
